s: Lightning is one of the most powerful forces in nature. Tavsiyenin amacını so that veriyor: so that bacteria from the surrounding environment cannot easily enter it. although şıkkı tavsiyenin sebebini zıtlıkla bağlıyor; açık yaranın iz bırakmadığını ya da havaya ihtiyaç duyduğunu söyleyen şıklar tavsiyeyle çelişiyor.

s: A child does not develop cystic fibrosis unless they inherit a faulty copy of the gene from both parents, which means that carriers of a single faulty copy usually remain healthy.
o: Tek bir kusurlu kopya taşıyanlar genellikle sağlıklı kaldığı için bir çocuk, kusurlu genin birer kopyasını her iki ebeveyninden de almadıkça kistik fibrozise yakalanmaz.

Bir çocuk, kusurlu genin birer kopyasını her iki ebeveyninden de almadıkça kistik fibrozise yakalanmaz; bu da tek bir kusurlu kopya taşıyanların genellikle sağlıklı kaldığı anlamına gelir.

o: Bellek hücreleri, bağışıklık sisteminin aynı patojen vücuda yeniden girdiğinde çok daha hızlı tepki verebilmesi için belirli bir patojenle bir kez karşılaşmasını sağlar.

s: The government has promised to ---- the gap between rich and poor regions by investing in roads, schools and hospitals in the least developed parts of the country.

measure
narrow
justify
disguise

s: Before the 1840s, sending a letter in Britain was expensive, and the cost was usually paid by the person who received it. ---- Because the new charge was low and paid in advance with a stamp, ordinary people could afford to write to one another. Within a few years, the number of letters sent each year had more than doubled.
o: Many people, therefore, refused to accept letters they had not asked for.
This cost, moreover, depended on the distance a letter travelled and the number of sheets it contained.
In 1840, this changed when a single low price was introduced for letters sent anywhere in the country.
However, most people at the time could not read or write.
Today, most letters have been replaced by emails and text messages.
a: Boşluktan sonra "the new charge" var; boşlukta yeni bir ücret tanıtılmalı. 1840'ta ülkenin her yerine tek ve düşük fiyat getirildiğini söyleyen şık bunu yapıyor. "This cost" ile başlayan şık eski ücreti anlatıyor, yeni bir ücret tanıtmıyor; "the new charge" boşta kalıyor.

s: Minimum wage laws set the lowest amount that employers are allowed to pay their workers. ---- Opponents, on the other hand, argue that forcing employers to pay more leads them to hire fewer people, especially the young and the unskilled. Economists have studied the question for decades without reaching a clear agreement.
o: In many countries, it is therefore adjusted every year to keep pace with inflation.
Some economists, for example, believe it should be abolished altogether.
The level at which it is set, moreover, varies widely from one country to another.
Supporters claim that such laws protect workers from exploitation and reduce poverty.
Wages, however, vary considerably from one industry to another.
a: İlk cümle asgari ücret yasasını tanımlıyor. Boşluktan sonra "Opponents, on the other hand" var: boşlukta karşı tarafın, yani destekçilerin görüşü olmalı. "Supporters claim that such laws protect workers…" bu karşıtlığı kuruyor. Ücretin ülkeden ülkeye değiştiğini ekleyen şık bir taraf sunmuyor.

s: Tourism is one of the largest industries in the world and a vital source of income for many developing countries. ---- Historic city centres become crowded, prices rise beyond the reach of local residents, and fragile natural sites suffer lasting damage. Several popular destinations have therefore begun to limit the number of visitors they admit each day.
o: As a result, many governments spend large sums advertising their countries abroad.
Yet its benefits come at a cost that is increasingly difficult to ignore.
Visitors, for example, now book most of their holidays online.
This income, moreover, often supports traditional crafts that might otherwise disappear.

s: For most of history, the majority of people could neither read nor write. ---- In the Ottoman Empire, for example, the first Turkish printing house did not open until 1727, nearly three centuries after Gutenberg. As schools spread in the nineteenth century, literacy rose rapidly, transforming politics, work and family life.
o: The invention of printing, however, quickly made books available to everyone.
Most ancient texts, as a result, survived only because they were copied by hand.
Today, more than four out of five adults in the world can read.
Newspapers, for example, became cheap enough for workers to buy in the 1830s.

s: Public opinion polls have become an essential part of modern politics. ---- The classic example is the 1936 American presidential election, when a magazine that had polled more than two million readers predicted the wrong winner, because its readers were wealthier than the average voter. Modern polling companies therefore devote enormous effort to selecting samples that represent the whole population.
o: Their accuracy, however, depends less on how many people are asked than on who is asked.
The first opinion poll was conducted by a local newspaper in Pennsylvania during the election of 1824.
Most polls today are carried out by telephone or over the internet.
Politicians often commission private polls before announcing a new policy.

a: Boşluktan sonra "The classic example" ile iki milyon kişiye sorup yanlış tahmin yapan anket geliyor. s: Trade unions first appeared in Britain during the Industrial Revolution. ---- Their members pooled small weekly payments to support one another in times of sickness or unemployment, and they negotiated with employers over wages and hours.
